text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet's Classic year has finally begun...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This spring will be a crucial turning point, one on which Tanino Gimlet bets her entire life so far.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that as her Trainer I couldn't afford to waste a single second,
I was working diligently from early morning on New Year's Day when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the sound of someone knocking echoed.
I called out, but received no response...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I stepped out of the trainer's office and looked around the hallway, but no one was there. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An envelope was left in front of the door.
I had a very strong suspicion about who left it,
but checked inside just in case. And then—
choice_data_list: (..."Upon the stage of this now-dormant school")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A few candidate spots came to mind, but guessing that Tanino Gimlet would probably like this kind of place, I headed over—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Huh, Gim-senpai's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ouss! Happy New Year!
Did Gim-senpai call you over too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Vodka, did you see the riddle and come here too?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A mystery...? But all the letter said was
'Come to the stage'—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Welcome, guided lost souls.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting, solitary indulgence for today only...
Welcome to Bar Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The dawn of a new year. The alignment of the stars—
Allow me to bestow upon you all a cup worthy of such an occasion...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this supposed to be a surprise...!?
That's so stylish and cool...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Serving it on an outdoor stage must be part of her personal aesthetic.
It would be boorish of me to question it..."
choice_data_list: Master, do they have a menu here?
Master, I wonder if they have a menu here?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. This is an aesthetic cradle that welcomes
all lost souls.
If you wish for it, it shall become destiny—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Tanino Gimlet pulled out a memo from seemingly nowhere
with three cryptic menu names written on it and handed it over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right below the drink names, "MOCKTAILS" is printed
in small letters, politely indicating that they are non-alcoholic.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Will the three shed tears recorded here
become benevolence toward you, or poison—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From the three menus presented, the one chosen was—
choice_data_list: "Requiem for Those Who Lament Their Powerlessness"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
—Vodka, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Um... then I'll have the same thing...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well.
Then—savor it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take a sip of the offered mocktail.
After an initial hint of bitterness, a rich sweetness gently unfolds—it's truly an eye-opening drink...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—At first it was a little bitter and surprised me,
but then this immense sweetness came right after!
So this is what requiem tastes like...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was really delicious, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gim-senpai! Thank you so mu—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!
There's something where Gim-senpai was standing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking there, another letter had arrived.
Opening it up, Vodka and I checked the contents together—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"With this cup, let us herald the beginning.
HAPPY NEW YEAR. Hollow pleasures shall simply fade away without a sound."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, even her exit was so cool!
Still…… I wanted to talk to her a little more~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, together with Vodka, I received a very Tanino Gimlet-esque New Year's greeting.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Narrator

I take a sip of the offered mocktail.
A fruity, rich sweetness permeates throughout my entire body...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“—It's super fruity, and my throat feels so blessed or whatever...!
So this is what mercy tastes like~~...!”
